channel.title: What Is Being Built — Daily Activity Feed
channel.description: Daily updates on open-source automated research tools: commits, releases, and community activity.

item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-04
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects recently. The `tenzing` and `scrutiny` projects have focused on refining their user interfaces and experiences, with updates to site builds and alert titles. Meanwhile, `oddpub` has expanded its ontogenerator capabilities to include nature das and cas detection. The `docpluck` project has made notable releases, including updates to its glyph module and documentation for triage and handoff. Additionally, `escicheck` has synced with `escicheckapp` to incorporate the latest `effectcheck` versions, and `auto-zcurve` has addressed installation issues with its Windows 64-bit and R installers. These updates demonstrate the connections and collaborations within our community, and we celebrate the progress being made across these open-source research tools.

39 commits across 7 active repositories this week.

New releases: auto-zcurve v0.11.1

Dormant repos revived: scrutiny, escicheck

item.title: docpluck: 7 commits today
item.description:
giladfeldman/docpluck

The main branch was the focus of the recent work, with several commits made to it. The documentation for triage and handoff was updated, with commits noting that "run-4 close — W0n shipped (v2.4.118); maier η²p adjudicated OCR-tier; punch-list current" and "run-3 close — W0l+W0m shipped (v2.4.116/117); punch-list current", indicating the completion of runs 3 and 4. A release was made for the glyph module, with a commit message stating "W0n p-threshold dropped-decimal recovery — v2.4.118", and another release was made with "W0m β-as-'b' layout-gated recovery — v2.4.117 packaging". Additionally, a chore commit preserved the "run-3 guard-diff + FP-scan scripts under tools/diag/", and a restore commit recovered "107 uncommitted lines lost to 2026-07-20 Dropbox sync damage". Another commit updated the documentation for handoff, noting "run-4 fresh-session handoff — clear the run-3 punch-list and continue iterating".
